mechanism: Selegiline (MAOI at higher doses) combined with timolol's sympathomimetic effects and systemic absorption from ophthalmic formulation may increase hypertension and tachycardia risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; use timolol ophthalmic cautiously in patients on selegiline, particularly at doses >10mg/day, and consider alternative beta-blockers with less systemic absorption.
